about.html:
“Rhea has the drive of an entrepreneur, the mind of a scientist and the heart of a healer. She has a focused vision and an impressive speed of execution. This is due in part to her unwavering commitment, her natural ability as a community builder and leader, and the rigour she brings to the products, ideas, and services she creates. She makes an excellent collaborator and we are just witnessing the start of her success. Big things to come.”

Dr. Rhea Mehta is a scientist, wellness visionary, and modern medicine woman blending data and devotion to help others reclaim their health and their power.

She holds a PhD in Molecular Toxicology and Nutritional Biochemistry and has spent over a decade working at the intersection of science, health innovation, and holistic health. As the co-founder of Aste Wellness, a ritual-led Ayurvedic skincare brand born from her own hormone healing journey, Rhea helps women reconnect with their bodies through hormone-safe, soul-aligned products and practices.

An award-winning Mantra Artist, Rhea released her debut EP Soul Ceremony in 2021 — an immersive collection of sacred sounds designed to awaken presence, peace, and connection. Her music is an extension of her healing work, weaving ancient mantras into modern soundscapes to invite stillness, emotional release, and transformation.

Rhea is also the founder of Global Smoothie Day, a global movement to inspire plant-powered living; co-founder of Bowhead Health, a blockchain-enabled healthtech platform for personalized and secure health data ownership; and co-founder of Reset, a tech-free wellness camp focused on healing through play, nature, and inner work.

As a featured expert with MindBodyGreen, The Spruce, and multiple health media platforms, Rhea blends Western scientific training with Eastern healing lineages – drawing from her certifications in Integrative Nutrition, Kriya Yoga (including Prenatal), and Sound Ceremony.

She has spoken on stages across the globe on topics ranging from environmental toxicity to nutritional healing and women’s wellness, and she brings a unique blend of grounded expertise and intuitive presence to every room she enters.

Above all, Rhea is a mother, a daughter, and a lifelong student of the body’s innate wisdom. Her work is a remembrance: that science can be sacred, and healing begins within.

My Story

I was born in a small Northern Canadian town to Indian immigrant parents – my mother from India and my father, a refugee from East Africa. As a child, I struggled with chronic digestive issues and inflammatory pain, but my family’s deep-rooted love and resilience gave me an early sense of strength.

It wasn’t until my twenties, while completing my PhD in Molecular Toxicology, that I hit my breaking point. Years of high stress and disconnection from my body led to a serious health crisis – one that no textbook could solve. That wake-up call forced me to turn the scientific lens inward and begin my own healing journey.

My path back began with real food — specifically, daily green smoothies, superfoods, and deep detoxification. I removed as many environmental toxins as I could, from what I ate and drank to what I put on my skin and stored in my home. I began to rebuild my body and rewire my nervous system through rituals that honoured simplicity, intention, and consistency.

That path soon led me to my ancestral practices: Vedic chanting, breathwork, and yoga. When I lost my father to digestive cancer, my devotion to holistic health deepened. And when I became a mother, everything I’d learned was tested again.

These moments shaped the way I view wellness: not as perfection, but as practice. Not as a fix, but as a return. 

Today, my work is rooted in that lived experience. I support women in navigating their own healing journeys, from hormonal imbalance to burnout recovery, through a blend of science, intuition, and ancestral wisdom. Because healing isn’t linear, but it is possible. And we don’t have to walk it alone.

FEATURED PAST WORK

Scientific research, articles and publications:

  • Scientific compendium on medicinal mushrooms  written for Vibe Mushrooms
  • Doctoral thesis  on investigating the cytoprotective mechanisms of vitamins B6 and B1 against endogenous-toxin induced oxidative stress
  • 5 activities that will help you cleanse
  • 4 Years. 7 Cleanses. 3 Lessons. A Toxicologist Explains

Talks

  • Blockchain meets healthcare  at HealthTO, Toronto
  • My formula for optimal living  at Do Lectures, Costa Rica

coaching.html:
“The program that Rhea has put together is life transforming! Rhea herself has a wealth of information and great hacks that I was able to tap into and still continue to do so. We usuallywait for tragedy to strike to make changes in our lives. Why wait! With this program I gained the awareness I was looking for with my body and mind connection. We often neglect the most important relationship we are having, and that’s with ourselves! Thank you for reminding me of this, Rhea!”

BOOK FREE CONSULTATION
ORDER YOUR FULLSCRIPT SUPPLEMENTS

Upgrade your health and environment with Dr. Rhea

As human beings, we are designed to self-heal. But over time, through daily exposure to processed foods, environmental stressors, and nutrient-depleted diets, our natural ability to cleanse and restore can become overwhelmed.

When this happens, it can show up as low energy, brain fog, poor digestion, headaches, body aches, or a general feeling of imbalance. Left unchecked, this internal buildup can begin to affect everything — from our mood and hormones to our long-term health.

The good news? There’s so much we can do, and it starts with listening to your body.

As a Toxicologist, Nutrition Scientist, and Health Coach, my role is to guide you back to balance with a personalized plan built around your unique body, your goals, and your lifestyle. We’ll talk deeply to understand your full picture, and if needed, explore testing to get even more clarity.

From there, I’ll be your partner and guide – offering education, accountability, and support every step of the way. You’ll receive simple, actionable tools like meal plans, recipes, supplement suggestions, and mindful rituals to help you shift from burnout to vibrant health.

This work isn’t about perfection, it’s about creating new patterns that feel good and stick. Together, we’ll build a rhythm that works for you, and help you reconnect to a body that knows how to heal.

“

You are directly responsible for saving my life.

Adam P
“

I am fascinated by Dr. Rhea’s over the top knowledge as a fellow health professional. Dr. Rhea has improved my gut issues 10 fold. She helped me regain the confidence and control I needed to ensure self-care and mindful eating. Her steps have healed me, my cravings, and my eating habits immensely.

Dr. Neeta Bhushan
“

Through our work together, I built healthier daily habits and learned how to better manage my daily routine. One of the most impactful parts of Rhea’s approach was the opportunity to explore and experiment with a variety of supplements I had never heard of before. This opened the door to new ways of supporting my health and gave me practical tools to fine-tune my nutrition and overall wellness. Her personal investment in my well-being went far beyond what I ever expected, and it made a lasting difference in my life.

AV
“

After working with Rhea I felt like I had a better handle on how to regulate my emotional body with various practices and food. I had daily habits that felt achievable in my lifestyle and impactful for my overall well being. It was so lovely having a cheerleader for my body and offering narrative shifts when needed.

Parul Bansal
“

I was coming off of a kidney stone. And waking up with my heart racing. Working with Rhea was one of the first times that I learned what it truly meant to feel safe in my body. I was able to sleep soundly. Focus better. And most importantly, build a relationship with my body and heart where I felt capable and empowered.

Priya
“

Dr. Rhea brings to the arena of health a burning desire to truly help people. She is a shining star in the area of healthy and conscious living.

Dr. Sachin Patel

PACKAGES

BOOK 1 HOUR PRIVATE CONSULTATION

One-on-one consultation with Dr. Rhea, focusing on your unique health and wellness needs. Gain expert insights and personalized guidance to kickstart your personalized health journey.

CLEAN SWEEP - 3 MONTHS

This 3-month foundational coaching container is designed to help you clean sweep your inner and outer environment so you can show up in your life with more clarity, energy, and purpose. Together, we’ll map out and implement a personalized wellness plan that integrates evidence-based nutrition, functional lifestyle practices, and detoxification support — all tailored to your unique needs.

This is for you if you’re ready to shift patterns that no longer serve you, reclaim vitality, and reconnect with your body as a source of wisdom and strength.

What’s Included

Six 1:1 Coaching Sessions (60 min biweekly, via Zoom)
Personalized sessions covering nutrition, mindset, nervous system support, energy rituals, and daily habit refinement

Health History Review + Metabolic Typing Assessment
We’ll begin with a deep intake to identify imbalances, stressors, and opportunity areas for healing

Your Clean Sweep Wellness Blueprint
A fully customized protocol including dietary shifts, supplement suggestions, movement practices, and self-care tools to support whole-body renewal

Clean Sweep Resources Bundle

    • Clean Sweep Meal Plan & Recipes
    • Shopping List for Whole-Body Reset
    • Personalized Supplement Guide
    • Ritual & Self-Care Accessories (where applicable)

Symptom & Habit Tracker 
A custom tracking system to monitor physical symptoms, emotional patterns, and daily rituals

Session Notes & Recap

All recommendations shared in a Google Doc after each session for easy implementation

Unlimited Email Support
For questions, check-ins, and guidance between sessions

MAINTENANCE - 1x/MONTH

1 one-hour coaching session per month. This program is offered to existing clients would would like to continue beyond the 3-month coaching container with additional support on a flexible schedule.

BOOK FREE CONSULTATION

MY COACHING FRAMEWORK

I’ve broken down the path to optimal living into four steps, and my goal is to guide you in each of these areas to support you on this transformative journey.

Dream

Paint a multi-sensory picture of your best self

Design

Optimize your schedule to support your daily intentions and goals

Clean

Identify and discard triggers from your body and lifestyle

Fuel

Resolve inefficiencies in body and mind through functional nutrition, detoxification, and supplementation

himalayan-breathwork.html:
”Himalayan breathwork is hands down some of the most transformative meditation practices I have done. Rhea is a clear, grounded, loving, knowledgeable guide and teacher, who not only shares the practices, but also the meaning, intention and wisdom behind them. She holds a powerful container to guide the body into transcendent states of clarity.

Kriya Breathwork and Sound Yoga

In 2019, I traveled to Rishikesh, India — the birthplace of yoga — to study under Himalayan masters and reconnect with my ancestral roots. There, on the banks of the Ganges in the Himalayan foothills, I earned my 200-hour certification in ancient Vedic Kriya and Kundalini Breathwork. In 2020, I deepened my training with an additional 100-hour Prenatal Kriya certification.

Kriya, meaning “action that leads to liberation,” is a powerful blend of breath, movement, and sound designed to clear energy channels, calm the nervous system, and connect us to higher consciousness. Unlike modern yoga’s focus on movement alone, Kriya works on the subtle body — detoxifying, awakening dormant energy, and aligning us with our dharmic path.

These ancient techniques have transformed my own life, leaving me feeling energetically clear, deeply connected to my soul, and grounded in purpose. Today, I share them to help others access the same inner stillness, vitality, and expansion.

“

Rhea's guidance is deeply meaningful - you can tell that she believes deeply in the work and that the practice she shares is one she has invested in deeply herself.

Stephanie Ngan
“

Rhea's breathwork came at a time where I was really looking for new ways to dive in, and she offered exactly that. She is a knowledgeable and intuitive guide who helped me explore a new practice, and deepen my relationship with my body.

SN
“

Attending Rhea's kriya yoga session was a deeply transformative experience that touched me on multiple levels — physically, emotionally, and spiritually. During the practice, I felt a surprising physical release — a tingling in my spine and warmth in my chest — almost as if something dormant had begun to stir. Emotionally, I experienced waves of clarity and even unexpected tears, not from sadness, but from a feeling of being seen and cleansed. Spiritually, it felt like a homecoming — subtle but profound, like reconnecting with a part of myself I hadn’t realized I’d lost touch with.

Rachana Bontra
“

Rhea’s voice was beautiful and strong as she chanted the mantras, guiding us to tap into our intuitive strengths. Her guidance was clear and grounded, yet infused with something sacred. I left feeling lighter, more centered, and profoundly connected.

RB
“

Rhea emits vibrant energy in her sessions. One can’t feel low and monotonous in her presence.

Himanshu

SNAPSHOT OF SESSIONS WITH RHEA

WORK WITH RHEA

AS SEEN ON

DR. RHEA MEHTA

Is a scientist, healer and innovator known for being on the pulse of what the world needs, often before it knows it.

For the past 20 years, Dr. Rhea has worked as a holistic health coach and toxicologist helping women reclaim their health through nutrition science, detox protocols, and more recently, fertility support and postpartum recovery. She’s Science-backed & Ayurveda-informed.

She is the co-founder of Aste Wellness, a ritual-led skincare brand rooted in Ayurvedic wisdom. From smoothies to psychedelics, breathwork to blockchain, Rhea has long been a voice at the leading edge of healing, blending ancient practices with future-facing technologies to empower more conscious, connected living.

With a PhD in Molecular Toxicology and Nutritional Biochemistry, Certification in Integrative Nutrition & Health Coaching, and Teacher Trainings in Kriya Yoga and Sound Ceremony, her work bridges East and West, bringing science and soul into sacred conversation.

An award-winning Mantra Artist, Rhea released her debut EP, Soul Ceremony, in 2021, an immersive collection of sacred sounds designed to awaken presence, peace, and connection. Her music is an extension of her healing work, weaving ancient mantras into modern soundscapes to invite stillness and transformation.

Rhea is founding team member of Diamond Therapeutics, a mental health company pioneering non-hallucinogenic psychedelics, the founder of Global Smoothie Day, a movement to inspire healthy living, Co-founder of Bowhead Health, a privacy-first health tech company leveraging AI for clinical trials, and Reset, a tech-free wellness camp designed to reconnect adults to self.

Her work is a remembrance: that science can be sacred, and that healing begins within.

Download speaker kit

Aste Wellness founder speaker kit

“There is something a little bit magical about Rhea Mehta. Maybe it’s all the superfoods she eats. She radiates good health and is a fountainhead of wisdom about all aspects of deep nutrition and even deeper living. Prepare to be supercharged. ”

Jeff WarrenAuthor and Meditation Teacher

MY STORY

I was born in a small Northern Canadian town to Indian immigrant parents. My mother from India, and my father a refugee from East Africa. My earliest memories are of navigating chronic health challenges with few resources, but anchored by a quiet resilience and unwavering hope.

Years later, while completing my PhD in Molecular Toxicology, a personal health crisis forced me to turn the scientific lens inward. That was the beginning of my healing – through food, ritual, and a reconnection to breath.

When I lost my father to digestive cancer, that healing deepened.

When I became a mother, it was tested all over again.

These moments have shaped the way I see wellness – not as perfection, but as devotion.

Today, I help others reclaim their health as a holistic health coach and toxicologist, through ancient wisdom, conscious science, and a remembering of what’s already within. 

Work with me.

RHEA’S APPROACH

My approach blends evidence-based science with root-cause holistic healing to help you return to your most energized, empowered self.

As a holistic health coach, toxicologist, and nutrition scientist, I guide you through a personalized journey of healing, rooted in deep listening, strategic insight, and sustainable transformation. Together, we’ll uncover the root causes of imbalance and co-create a plan that includes nutrition upgrades, healing rituals, and supportive habits tailored to your body’s needs.

I’ll be your guide, educator, and accountability partner, helping you move from intention to integration, until your wellness practices become second nature. This work is more than optimization. It’s a return to your truest self, and a lifestyle that reflects your vitality, clarity, and power.

When the moment calls for deeper integration, I draw on my training in Vedic (Indian) breathwork and kriya yoga to help you anchor into your body, regulate your nervous system, and reconnect with your inner knowing. Healing isn’t just physical – it’s emotional, spiritual, and deeply personal. These tools become part of the journey when you’re ready for them.

BOOK A CONSULTATION

“

The biggest impact Rhea’s approach had on me was that she taught as much as she coached, and truly practiced what she shared. She guided me through a detox protocol, but also gave me skills and hacks for a lifetime of understanding how to navigate my health and well-being. I learned about practices, supplements, foods, treatments and practitioners that still serve me today—all because Rhea took the time to do the research and experimentation so others could benefit from her learnings. Rhea is not only a well-th of knowledge, but also an inspired soul who truly believes in the power of nutrition, knowledge and intention for all people to thrive and live well.

Hima Batavia
“

Rhea’s passion is infectious. Her intrepid pursuit of her passion has inspired me to follow mine; and I’ll always be grateful to her for her limitless generosity.

Rahul Sarugaser
“

Dr. Rhea is unbelievably informed and conveys her message with pure love. True love of people, love of food, love of radiant health and love of knowledge. She is a joyful leader and a true healer.

Erin Diedling

With a PhD in Molecular Toxicology and Nutritional Biochemistry, Certification in Integrative Nutrition & Health Coaching, and Teacher Trainings in Kriya Yoga and Sound Ceremony, her work bridges East and West, bringing science and soul into sacred conversation.
An award-winning Mantra Artist, Rhea released her debut EP, Soul Ceremony, in 2021, an immersive collection of sacred sounds designed to awaken presence, peace, and connection. Rhea is founding team member of Diamond Therapeutics, a mental health company pioneering non-hallucinogenic psychedelics, the founder of Global Smoothie Day, a movement to inspire healthy living, Co-founder of Bowhead Health, a privacy-first health tech company leveraging AI for clinical trials, and Reset, a tech-free wellness camp designed to reconnect adults to self.

Soul Ceremony

Rhea’s Love for Indian Classical Music and Mantra Ritual

Rhea’s love for Indian classical music and mantra ritual are deeply rooted in her ancestry, upbringing, and yogic journey. After several years of classical vocal training with teachers including expert vocal coach and nationally broadcasted artist Stella Walker of Toronto, Canada, Rhea felt a strong desire to melodically carry the millennia old spiritual wisdom of her lineage into our collective hands.

Embedded with healing messages of liberation, unity, and peace, Rhea, in collaboration with award-winning producer and composer John Capek of Nashville, TN has infused ancient Indian mantras with western contemporary rhythm to bring forth a harmonious east meets west dynamic. Rhea’s hope is to enable those around the world to access and benefit from the magical sounds and spells originating in one of the oldest known spiritual bodies of wisdom, the Vedas.

Soul Ceremony is available worldwide on all major music streaming platforms.

ABOUT SOUL CEREMONY:

One of the most transformative aspects of yoga is missing in the West, and that is the ancient practice of rhythmically and repetitively chanting mantras, which helps us let go of our stressors and feel love in our hearts with relative ease. At this time of collective stress and struggle, we need practices that can help us drop in more easily and wash our worries away. My music is designed to do this.

Mantras are Sanskrit words, phrases, or sounds that originate in one of the oldest spiritual bodies of wisdom, known as the Vedas, which are at least 4000 years old. The word mantra means “to free from the mind.” Beyond the spiritual significance of each mantra lies the vibrational and resonant quality, which is ultimately responsible for evoking harmony within us. The outcome is a deep feeling of wholeness and oneness, of expansion and liberation, and of peace and unity. This inner discovery is the foundation of Soul Ceremony.

The five mantras in my debut EP were very carefully selected, based on their impact on my own spiritual practice and journey, and on their potency and meaning as described in the Vedas. I spent significant time meditating with each one, and believe that these reworkings that I’ve birthed into existence carry the magic of the versions that were originally downloaded by the sages of my ancestral lineage.

ABOUT RHEA’S FIRST SINGLE: BRIGHT LIGHT (GAYATRI MANTRA MIX)

The Gayatri mantra is considered one of the most important and powerful Vedic mantras. It was first recorded in the ancient Vedic text of the Rig Veda in Sanskrit around 2500-3000 years ago. Historically it has been recited by everyday people of India in their homes, as the sun rises or sets for purposes of purification and divine guidance.

I have a deep connection to this mantra, as it is one I recited before bed with my parents every single night until I left for University at the age of 17. Since then, I have been using it sporadically to heal my ruminating mind. I consciously reconnected with it at a yoga sound ceremony training in Guatemala in early 2019. There it was melodically shared with us, but through a western lens with poor pronunciation, which I did not resonate with. I felt it lost connection to the essence of the mantra.

After studying ancient meditation, tantra, and kriya yoga in the himalayan foothills of Rishikesh late 2019, I was (re)-initiated into the mantra tradition, and we were asked to recite the Gayatri mantra 6x at the end of our daily morning meditation practice. Since then it’s been playing in the background of my own movie.

Mantra in Sansrkit:

oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ
tat savitur vareṇyaṃ
bhargo devasya dhīmahi
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt

One of many translations: We meditate on the Spiritual Splendor of that supreme and Divine reality, source of the physical, astral and celestial spheres of existence. Allow that divine being supreme to illuminate our intellect, so that we can realize the supreme Truth.

I interpret the mantra as a bowing down to the sun, which represents the entirety of existence as we know it and the embodiment of knowledge and light. When we chant this mantra, we awaken to the presence of the sun’s knowledge and light within ourselves, which can cleanse, enlighten, and guide us.

Meaning of Individual Words:

ॐ – OM – The Primitive Sound

भूर् – BHUR – the physical world

भुवः – BHUVA – the mental world

स्वः – SVAHA – the celestial, the spiritual world

तत् – TAT – That, God; Transcendental Paramatma

सवितुर – SAVITUR – the Sun, the Creator, Preserver

वरेण्यं – VARENYAM – more adorable, lovely

भर्गो – BHARGO – shine, effulgence

देवस्य – DEVASYA – resplendent, supreme Lord

धीमहि – DEEMAHI – we meditate on

धियो यो – DHI YO – intelligence, understanding, Intellect

नः – NAH – Nah: our

प्रचोदयात् – PRACHODAYAT – enlighten, guide, inspire

More translations of the Gayatri mantra:

“We meditate on the glory of that Being who has produced this universe; may She enlighten our minds.”

– Swami Vivekananda

“We meditate on the adorable glory of the radiant sun; may She inspire our intelligence.”

– S. Radhakrishnan

“We choose the Supreme Light of the divine Sun; we aspire that it may impel our minds.”

– Sri Aurobindo
